original_record.paraphrased_claim: 1996 993, 129000 miles: burning/thrown belts; estimated 1–2 mm axial tip runout, tip contact, hub coating cracks and corroded blade edges. New fan later showed >1 mm tip rocking by light hand pressure.

original_record.paraphrased_claim: After powder-coating and trimming tips, owner finds a heavy side on low-friction shaft fixture; attempts added shallow holes without much change.
